sections.title: Get the foundations right
sections.intro: The basics AI checks for every business. None of these are optional, and all of them are within your control today.

items.title: Complete your Google Business Profile 100%
items.detail: Fill in every field — hours, photos, categories, services, a full description. AI leans heavily on complete, verified profiles.

items.title: Use the exact same name, address and phone everywhere
items.detail: AI cross-checks your details across sites. Even small inconsistencies (Pvt Ltd vs Private Limited, old phone numbers) make it trust you less.

items.title: Build a steady flow of genuine reviews
items.detail: Ask happy customers to review you, a few each week, and reply to every one. Steady, recent reviews are a strong trust signal — never buy or fake them.

items.title: Put your services and city in plain text on your site
items.detail: AI reads text, not pictures. Make sure what you do and where you do it is written out clearly — not trapped inside images or a logo.
